mods.name: Cut Content Restoration
mods.description: Restores dozens of unused missions, weapons, arts and Skells.
mods.author: threethan
mods.notes: Uses the mod's game data files; its Switch code plugin (exefs) is not needed on XCX Recomp. Changes data loaded at boot, so restart the game after turning it on or off. Missions or items it adds may vanish from a save made with it if it is removed.
